title: RLC 振铃：欠阻尼、临界阻尼、过阻尼
summary: 方波给 RLC 串联电路一次次加阶跃；转动电位器改变电阻，看电容电压从“叮——”地振荡到平稳上升。
description: 信号发生器（方波 0 ↔ 2 V、200 Hz）→ 电位器 RV1（1 kΩ，当可变电阻用）→ L1（10 mH）→ 结点 VC → C1（100 nF）→ GND。CH1 看输入，CH2 看 VC。

cards.title: 一个阶跃，叮——
text: - 照目标电路搭：信号发生器 → 电位器 **RV1 `1 kΩ`**（当可变电阻用：1 脚接信号，2 脚和 3 脚连在一起）→ **L1 `10 mH`** → 结点 **VC** → **C1 `100 nF`** → GND。
每个边沿之后，VC 在干什么？再慢慢往大转，它怎么变？

cards.title: 能量在电容和电感之间来回
text: - 电容把能量存成电压，电感把能量存成电流。电容放电，电流流进电感；电感不肯让电流停，又把电容充成反方向……能量就在两者之间来回，像弹簧上挂的重物。
- 来回一次的快慢只由 L 和 C 决定：
$$f_0 = \frac{1}{2π\sqrt{LC}} = \frac{1}{2π\sqrt{10 mH × 100 nF}}$$
- 电阻像空气阻力，每来回一次都吃掉一点能量。电阻小，振好多下才停（**欠阻尼**）；大到正好，一下也不振，最快地停在终点（**临界阻尼**）；再大，就慢吞吞地爬过去（**过阻尼**）。
![](fig:three)
![](fig:rlc)

cards.title: 读振荡，找临界点
text: - 电位器 **`5%`**：读 VC 振荡的频率（量相邻两个波峰的间隔 T_d，f = 1 / T_d）和第一个峰的最高电压。
- 转到 **`30%`** 再读一次最高电压：超调变小了多少？
- 慢慢往大转，找超调刚好消失的位置。那时回路电阻 ≈ 2√(L/C)，叫**临界电阻**；回路电阻 = 电位器 + 信号发生器 50 Ω + 线圈 1 Ω。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **二阶电路**有两个储能元件，能量来回交换，所以会振荡。
- **f0 = 1 / (2π√(LC))** 定快慢；电阻定振几下才停。
- **三种样子**：欠阻尼（振铃、超调）、临界阻尼（最快、不超调）、过阻尼（慢慢爬）。
- **真实电路里**：电容电压可以冲得比电源还高，电源滤波里要当心这种振铃。真实小电感的线圈电阻有 10–30 Ω，振铃会衰减得更快。

caption.text: 同一个 0 → 2 V 阶跃，三种回路电阻：小电阻振铃、冲过 2 V；临界电阻最快到达且不超调；大电阻慢慢爬上去。

i18n.en: The same 0 → 2 V step with three loop resistances: a small one rings and overshoots 2 V; the critical one arrives fastest without overshoot; a large one crawls up.

caption.text: 同一个电流穿过电阻、电感、电容。电阻 R 是整个回路的电阻：电位器 + 信号发生器的 50 Ω + 线圈的 1 Ω。

i18n.en: One current passes the resistor, the inductor and the capacitor. R is the whole loop's resistance: pot + the generator's 50 Ω + the coil's 1 Ω.

en.title: RLC ringing: under-, critically and over-damped
en.summary: A square wave gives a series RLC circuit one step after another; turn a pot to change the resistance and watch the capacitor voltage go from ringing to a smooth rise.
en.description: Generator (square 0 ↔ 2 V, 200 Hz) → pot RV1 (1 kΩ, used as a variable resistor) → L1 (10 mH) → node VC → C1 (100 nF) → GND. CH1 on the input, CH2 on VC.
en.compare:
**Compare**: f0 = 1 / (2π√(10 mH × 100 nF)) ≈ **5.03 kHz**; critical resistance 2√(10 mH / 100 nF) ≈ **632 Ω**.
- **5%** (loop about 101 Ω, ζ ≈ 0.16, underdamped): rings at about 5 kHz, about 60 % overshoot, peak about **3.2 V**; the falling edge likewise undershoots below 0 V to about −1.2 V.
- **30%** (about 351 Ω, ζ ≈ 0.56): about 12 % overshoot, peak about **2.25 V**.
- **60%** (about 651 Ω, ζ ≈ 1.03, about critical): no overshoot, the quickest smooth arrival at 2 V.
- **100%** (about 1051 Ω, ζ ≈ 1.66, overdamped): no overshoot either, but a clearly slower rise.
Damping ratio ζ = (R/2)·√(C/L), with R the total loop resistance.
hints: Pot as a variable resistor: pin 1 to the generator, pin 2 (wiper) and pin 3 joined by a wire, then on to the inductor.
Inductor and capacitor in series: VC is the point between them, the capacitor's other end on GND.
Critical resistance 2√(L/C); the loop resistance includes the generator's 50 Ω.

measurements.ask: Pot at 5%: VC's ringing frequency (time two neighbouring peaks, T_d; f = 1 / T_d)
measurements.explain: When underdamped the ringing frequency is f_d = f0·√(1 − ζ²); with this little damping it is only about 1 % below f0 ≈ 5.03 kHz.

measurements.ask: Pot at 5%: VC's highest voltage (the first peak)
measurements.explain: About 60 % overshoot, so the peak ≈ 2 + 2 × 0.6 ≈ 3.2 V — above the signal's 2 V.
The loop resistance is about 351 Ω, much more damping: only about 12 % overshoot is left, peak ≈ 2.25 V.

measurements.ask: Turning the pot slowly: about where does the overshoot just disappear (critical damping)?
measurements.explain: At 30% there is still about 12 % overshoot; when the loop resistance, pot + 50 Ω + 1 Ω, reaches 2√(L/C) ≈ 632 Ω (about 60%) the overshoot goes; beyond that it is overdamped and only slower.
choices: only at 100% is there no overshoot

cards.title: One step, and it rings
text: - Build the target circuit: generator → pot **RV1 `1 kΩ`** (as a variable resistor: pin 1 to the signal, pins 2 and 3 joined) → **L1 `10 mH`** → node **VC** → **C1 `100 nF`** → GND.
- Generator: square, **`200 Hz`**, amplitude **`1 V`**, offset **`1 V`** (0 ↔ 2 V). CH2 on VC.
- Turn the pot to **`5%`**.
What does VC do after every edge? Turn the pot up slowly — how does it change?

cards.title: Energy swings between C and L
text: - A capacitor stores energy as voltage, an inductor as current. The capacitor discharges into the inductor; the inductor won't let the current stop and charges the capacitor the other way round… The energy swings between them, like a weight on a spring.
- How fast it swings depends on L and C only:
$$f_0 = \frac{1}{2π\sqrt{LC}} = \frac{1}{2π\sqrt{10 mH × 100 nF}}$$

- The resistance is like air drag, eating some energy on every swing. Small R: many swings before it stops (**underdamped**); just right: no swing at all and the quickest arrival (**critically damped**); larger still: a slow crawl (**overdamped**).
![](fig:three)
![](fig:rlc)

cards.title: Read the ringing, find the critical point
text: - Pot at **`5%`**: read the ringing frequency of VC (time two neighbouring peaks, T_d, then f = 1 / T_d) and the top of the first peak.
- At **`30%`** read the top again: how much smaller is the overshoot?
- Turn it up slowly and find where the overshoot just disappears. There the loop resistance ≈ 2√(L/C), the **critical resistance**; the loop resistance = pot + generator 50 Ω + coil 1 Ω.

cards.title: Take away
text: - A **second-order circuit** has two energy stores that trade energy back and forth, so it can oscillate.
- **f0 = 1 / (2π√(LC))** sets the pace; the resistance sets how many swings before it stops.
- **Three shapes**: underdamped (ringing, overshoot), critically damped (fastest without overshoot), overdamped (slow crawl).

- **In a real circuit**: the capacitor can overshoot above the supply, so watch out for ringing in power-supply filters. A real small inductor has 10–30 Ω of winding resistance, so the ringing dies faster.

tests.name: 电位器 60%（临界阻尼）：不超调

measurements.ask: 电位器 5%：VC 振荡的频率（量相邻两个波峰的间隔 T_d，f = 1 / T_d）
measurements.explain: 欠阻尼时振荡频率 f_d = f0·√(1 − ζ²)；这里阻尼很小，只比 f0 ≈ 5.03 kHz 低约 1%。

measurements.ask: 电位器 5%：VC 的最高电压（第一个峰）
measurements.explain: 超调约 60%，峰值 ≈ 2 + 2 × 0.6 ≈ 3.2 V：比信号的 2 V 还高。

measurements.ask: 电位器 30%：VC 的最高电压
measurements.explain: 回路电阻约 351 Ω，阻尼大了不少：只剩约 12% 的超调，峰值 ≈ 2.25 V。

choices: 只有转到 100% 才不超调
measurements.ask: 慢慢转电位器：超调刚好消失（临界阻尼）大约在哪个位置？
measurements.explain: 30% 时还有约 12% 的超调；回路电阻 = 电位器 + 50 Ω + 1 Ω 达到 2√(L/C) ≈ 632 Ω（约 60%）时超调消失，再大就是过阻尼，只会更慢。

hints: 电位器当可变电阻：1 脚接信号发生器，2 脚（滑动端）和 3 脚用一根线连起来，再接电感。
电感和电容串联：VC 是它们中间那一点，电容另一端接 GND。
临界电阻 2√(L/C)；回路电阻里要算上信号发生器的 50 Ω。
